exposure: Induction method (intra-cervical dilatation balloon vs. prostaglandin)
cohort: 176 women with breech presentation at term (36 weeks gestation), singleton pregnancy, no contraindications to vaginal delivery, and an unfavorable cervix (Bishop score <6)
finding: The mode of delivery after induction with an intra-cervical dilatation balloon was similar to that of prostaglandin in women with breech presentations, but half of the women in the balloon group required additional prostaglandin maturation.
